title: Terminologies Related To The Space Science
definition: Comprehensive lexicon of astrophysical, orbital, cosmological, and instrumental terms essential for understanding advanced space missions and observational astronomy.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (Science & Tech) via direct conceptual definitions of orbits, cosmic phenomena, and spacecraft parameters, and crucial for Mains GS-3 applications in space technology and satellite deployments.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Terminologies Related To The Space Science.
Evaluate spatial distribution, orbital mechanics, and astrophysical phenomena.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic Physics and Astronomy concepts from NCERT Class VI-XII
